### Are the Lost Worth the Cost?
Author: Will Graham
Site: Billy Graham Evangelistic Association
URL: https://billygraham.org/lp/75-day-devotional-day-64
Passage: Luke 15:10
Points:
- Reaching people who are far from God demands personal sacrifice and expenditure of valuable resources.
- Seeking the lost requires an intentional, labor-intensive investment of time, symbolized by sweeping the house.
- Believers must display patience, emotional commitment, and thoroughness by refusing to give up the search.
- Heaven erupts in joy whenever a sinner turns to God, showing that every individual soul is worth the cost.

### Loving Like Jesus
Author: Gwen Smith
Site: Crosswalk
URL: https://www.crosswalk.com/devotionals/girlfriends/girlfriends-in-god-november-19-2020.html
Passage: Luke 15:10
Points:
- God and the angels in heaven celebrate with pure elation when a lost sinner turns back to Him.
- Jesus engaged and welcomed marginalized outcasts as they were, rather than waiting for them to clean up first.
- Believers should beware of dismissing or avoiding people who look, act, or believe differently from themselves.
- Christians are called to share the heart of Christ by seeking out and treasuring people whom society often overlooks.
